description: This file defines a Java class 'LocalHostServiceHandle' which extends 'ServiceHandle'. It provides specialized behavior indicating it represents a service running on the local host, with methods to indicate if the service is on the same process, local host, or remote host. It contains constructors for initialization with service details and overrides methods from the parent class to specify its local host properties.

classes.name: LocalHostServiceHandle
classes.description: A ServiceHandle implementation representing a service running in a different VM on the same host, facilitating IPC and event data marshaling/unmarshaling.

methods.name: LocalHostServiceHandle
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handle with service name, IPC identifier, event identifier, and optional visibility.

methods.name: isSameProcess
methods.description: Indicates whether the service runs in the same process; overridden to return false.

methods.name: isLocalHost
methods.description: Indicates whether the service is on the local host; overridden to return true.

methods.name: isRemoteHost
methods.description: Indicates whether the service is on a remote host; overridden to return false.
